plugin.name: xWeatherRouting
plugin.summary: Weather routing with Main/Quick engines and arrival planning.
plugin.author: Sean d'Epagnier; Weather Routing Plugin Team
plugin.description: WeatherRouting offers Main and Quick engines with independent saved settings and explicit search presets. It computes land-aware sailing routes using deterministic forward isochrones, reverse recovery, graph fallback, concurrent departure optimisation, and planned-arrival routing. Stock OpenCPN uses GSHHS land checks; optional chart-backed safety is available only when the host provides it.
